resources.string:
After this update, Nyanime’s roadmap will change: instead of adding new features, we’ll focus on improving the ones already here, fixing bugs and making the app more stable.

Once this work is complete, Nyanime 1.0.0.0 will be released.

From then on, very frequent updates will resume, with something new almost every day.
